title: 第5章 被偷走的老汤饥饿的师妹第6章 瑶池圣主的会议机智的御兽峰主
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
回到自己的小院之后，林东方请萧曦月给老汤锅下面布置了一个火属性法阵。
但凡卤味店都有一锅老汤。
这老汤是不能熄火的，里面的残渣每天都要过滤，只剩下老汤一直在熬。
随着时间的推移，香味会愈发的浓郁厚重。
到最后，随便丢进去一个鞋底泡一泡都是人间绝味。
有了火属性法阵就不用一直添柴了。
林东方第一次觉得厨和道有机结合在了一起。
回屋闷头大睡！
……
天蒙蒙亮，火灵儿闻着香味来到林东方小院外。
熟练的翻过院墙，溜进了厨房！
她小手里还抓着一颗鸡蛋，还有一把刚揪下来的青菜叶。
这几天她已经学会了偷摸用林东方的老汤自己做蛋花汤了！
远处，离火峰首座李金炎黑着脸看着自己的外外外甥孙女火灵儿。
收徒大会上，他差点给这个小祖奶奶跪下了，可惜对方执意要拜入妙音峰。
给他气的原地自燃！
这几天几夜他都睡不着觉！
信步就来到林东方的小院外，打算看看这个厨仙体的门道。
结果看到火灵儿熟练的翻进林东方的小院，他气的老脸发黑，白胡子翘了翘。
这成何体统！

等火灵儿进了厨房，他也跟了进去。
他打算好好劝劝火灵儿，让对方弃暗投明！
朱雀血脉跑去学什么音杀之术不是糟践了这火道天赋？
只见兴高采烈的火灵儿哼着小曲，掀开了锅盖。
然后她脖子向后仰了仰，小脸上的表情从震惊然后变成惊恐！
仿佛那锅里藏着什么绝世大恐怖一样！
“汤！”
“汤呢！
？”
火灵儿尖叫一声，头顶呆毛一颤，几乎昏厥！
她早起的动力，就这么没了！
锅里干干净净，连一丝油花都不剩！
此时，李金炎走进厨房，咳嗽一声。
content_en:
After returning to his small courtyard, Lin Dongfang asked Xiao Xiyue to arrange a fire attribute circle under the old soup pot.
Every braised food restaurant has a pot of old soup.
This old soup cannot be turned off. The residue inside has to be filtered every day, leaving only the old soup that has been simmering.
As time goes by, the fragrance will become stronger and thicker.
In the end, just throwing in a shoe sole and soaking it in it will taste amazing in the world.
With the fire attribute array, there is no need to keep adding firewood.
For the first time, Lin Dongfang felt that cooking and Taoism were organically combined.
Go back home and fall asleep!
…
At dawn, Huo Ling'er smelled the fragrance and came outside Lin Dongfang's courtyard.
Skillfully climbed over the courtyard wall and slipped into the kitchen!
She was holding an egg in her little hand and a handful of freshly picked green cabbage leaves.
In the past few days, she has learned to secretly make egg drop soup using Lin Dongfang’s old soup!
In the distance, Li Jinyan, the leader of Lihuo Peak, looked at his niece Huo Ling'er with a dark face.
At the disciple recruitment meeting, he almost knelt down in front of this little grandma, but unfortunately she insisted on joining Miaoyin Peak.
Make him so angry that he spontaneously combusts on the spot!
He couldn't sleep these days and nights!
He strolled outside Lin Dongfang's small courtyard, intending to take a look at the doorway of this Kitchen Immortal Body.
When he saw Huo Ling'er skilfully climbing into Lin Dongfang's courtyard, his old face turned black with anger and his white beard curled up.
What a shame!
When Huo Ling'er entered the kitchen, he followed suit.
He planned to persuade Huo Ling'er to abandon the secret and turn to the light!
Didn't the Suzaku bloodline waste this fire talent by running to learn some sound-killing technique?
Huo Ling'er was seen humming a tune in high spirits and opened the lid of the pot.
Then she tilted her neck back, and the expression on her face changed from shock to horror!
It was as if there was some great horror hidden in that pot!
"Soup!"
“Where’s the soup!
? "
Huo Ling'er screamed, the hair on his head trembled, and he almost fainted!
Her motivation to get up early was just gone!
The pot is clean, not even a trace of oil is left!
At this time, Li Jinyan walked into the kitchen and coughed.
